evidence.title: GLM-5.3 (open-weight) beat Anthropic/OpenAI models – for 1/5 the cost

summary: The newly released GLM-5.3 open-weight model has surpassed performance benchmarks set by Anthropic and OpenAI, while operating at just one-fifth the cost. This development highlights the growing competitiveness of open-source AI alternatives in efficiency and capability.
title: Open-Weight GLM-5.3 Outperforms Leading AI Models at Fraction of the Cost
